justification: Inspected `core/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/jarscan/freqinlinesize/FreqInlineSizeOperation.java` and `core/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/jarscan/JarScan.java`. The target package contains a single class, is referenced directly only from `JarScan` (`new FreqInlineSizeOperation(...)`), and that class depends outward on `IJarScanOperation`, `MemberSignatureParts`, `MemberBytecode`, `BytecodeInstruction`, `StringUtil`, and `JITWatchConstants`. This gives the package 1 observed incoming reference versus several outgoing package dependencies, so it does not look like a stable package depending on less-stable ones. The imported model/util types are also widely reused elsewhere in the repo (`MemberSignatureParts` in 17 files, `MemberBytecode` in 19, `BytecodeInstruction` in 16, `StringUtil` in 31), which further weakens any unstable-dependency case.
